narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>The sum is only sometimes divisible by three, when the digits add to a multiple of three.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Try one, two, four. Its digits add to seven, yet the sum is seven hundred seventy seven.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Seven hundred seventy seven divided by three is two hundred fifty nine, with nothing left over.
removed_beats.on_screen: the hint card leaves; Chintu's bubble shows only sometimes divisible by 3; a test with 124: 124 + 241 + 412 = 777 and 777 ÷ 3 = 259; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='pick'/>To check, pick any three digits and add the number and its two cycles.
<bookmark mark='divide'/>Divide the sum by one hundred eleven. You should get the three digits added together.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor and the answer card; two check lines appear: pick any three digits and add the three cycles; divide by 111 to get the digit sum

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu thinks the sum is only sometimes divisible by three, when the digits add to a multiple of three. The sum is one hundred eleven times the digit sum, and one hundred eleven already holds a three.
